title: Reusable custom Hooks: Package a reusable stateful behavior in a custom Hook while keeping the caller's UI independent
description: A practical React 19 lesson for reusable custom hooks, with an intentionally failing starter, complete TypeScript instructor implementation, local assertions and honest runtime scope.
objectives: Package a reusable stateful behavior in a custom Hook while keeping the caller's UI independent.
Repair the broken behavior in the react-custom-hook starter.
Demonstrate correct and edge-case outcomes using offline tests.
rubric: I can articulate the React 19 contract for reusable custom hooks.
I can reproduce, repair and test the 06.04.02 starter case.
I can explain the difference between a local fixture and production persistence or browser behavior.
